name: Ring of Evasion

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Evade
powers.text: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, spend 1 charge and your Reaction to succeed instead (used automatically).

summary: 3 charges: when you fail a Dexterity save, a Reaction turns it into a success.
text: The ring holds 3 charges and regains 1d3 of them each dawn. Whenever a Dexterity saving throw of yours fails while you wear it, you can use your Reaction and spend 1 charge to turn the failure into a success.
